definitions.gloss: additional cost; extra charge; supplementary expense
definitions.explanation: A cost that is added on top of the base price or original budget.

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かかりません→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らんだ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: There were design changes midway through construction, and the additional costs ballooned significantly.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧ (addition) and ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (cost, expense). Frequently encountered in business contracts, service agreements, travel bookings, and construction projects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: additional costs arise
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}なし: no extra charge
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧: to charge an additional fee
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bear the additional cost

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}→追加料金：22313_tsuikaryoukin⟧: surcharge; extra fee — specifically for fees and service charges
- ⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: separate cost — implies a cost that is billed independently
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: expenses — general term for costs incurred in business or operations
